note: Triage of docs/reconcile_2026-11-13/identity_collisions.json (2026-11-13, refined pass). Four buckets, each a distinct reason the same dedupe_key maps to 2+ different-looking addresses -- most are explainable, NOT a real data bug: (1) likely_false_positive_same_street: every address shares the same street NAME (just different house numbers/units) -- one legal parcel covering a multi-building condo/apartment complex. (2) likely_false_positive_mobile_home: at least one address matches a manufactured-home description pattern (brand + WIDTHxLENGTH + MH + serial#) -- multiple mobile homes legitimately sitting on one land parcel; common in rural SC/NC counties (Dillon county alone: ~50 of these). (3) likely_false_positive_text_blob_address: at least one value is a long (>60 char) free-text blob, not a real address -- a scraper (public-notice/newspaper delinquent-tax-list parsers, e.g. Madison/Pitt/Polk NC) stuffed a whole notice sentence (PARCEL -- OWNER -- COUNTY DELINQUENT TAX $X OWED (PARCEL N)) into street_address when it had no clean address to extract, and multiple bills/years for the same real debt then collide under one key. Not a wrong-pick problem -- the field itself is being misused upstream; fixing it means the scraper, not the merge. (4) real_candidates: none of the above explain it -- genuinely worth live-verifying the way the 3 original buncombe_unpaid_bills PINs were fixed (those 3 are already patched and will still show up here since this file was not regenerated after that fix -- skip them).
